title: G/ATOR Screws/ Parts
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.USMC.MARCORP I&L.COMMANDER
description_text: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number M6700426Q0040 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ), for Replacement Parts for G/ATOR: P/N: 1410946-2 and P/N: 2000713-7 Aboard Marine Corps Logistics Base Ablany (MCLB Albany), ALbany, GA This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at https://www.acquisition.gov/far-overhaul Detailed instructions and requirement details can be found under the two (2) attachments of this combined synopsis/solicitation.
